Given this specific finding alongside your fatigue and concentration issues, do you have any history of unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or early satiety (feeling full quickly after eating small amounts)?

speaker: Patient
text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of digital pain improving with cold (acrocyanosis) is a classic sign of cold agglutinin disease; do you have any history of recent viral infections like EBV or Mycoplasma? I will also need to see your hemoglobin levels and a reticulocyte count to assess for anemia. REQUEST TEST: Hemoglobin, Reticulocyte_Count. REQUEST IMAGES: Peripheral_Blood_Smear_High_Resolution.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL (mild anemia); Reticulocyte_Count: 2.1% (low-normal). Peripheral_Blood_Smear_High_Resolution: Confirms presence of teardrop cells (dacrocytes), nucleated red blood cells, and increased abnormal platelets with dysplastic morphology; no evidence of cold agglutination or hemolysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of teardrop cells and nucleated red blood cells alongside thrombocytosis and dysplastic platelets strongly suggests a myelofibrotic process rather than cold agglutinin disease. Given your age, smoking history, and symptoms, have you noticed any enlargement in your abdomen or spleen, or any history of prior polycythemia? REQUEST TEST: Spleen_Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Spleen Ultrasound: Marked splenomegaly (enlarged spleen) noted, consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis. No focal masses or fluid collections observed.
